claims.statement: The checked Earth footprint is 1,024 by 1,024 metres at one-metre terrain spacing.
Route elevations, open-ground regions, and sightline occlusions are computed from the checked DTM, lidar surface, and orthophoto registration. Lidar surface is not used as a walkability mask.
Public event guidance places check-in at the gate, lets arrivals drive to a selected site to unload or settle a car-camping site, and requires tent campers to move vehicles to designated parking.
Lower and upper tent campers return through the lower gate, park in the west upper field, and walk back; lower car campers keep the car at camp; Middle Earth is not camping.

Austen traced a direct upper-to-middle connector and a clear middle-to-lower connector over the registered orthophoto; Gate 1 source-locks those vertices and composes them with short open-tier approaches.
Exact Gate 1 stops, road centerlines, campsite examples, and other non-traced placements are registered proposals over measured terrain, not centimetre-accurate field survey.
The useful task, night transformation, final choice, and route presentation are gameplay proposals.
The eight-metre night-heart mast is art direction only; no Gate 1 sightline result depends on its height.

checks.name: canon-conflicts
checks.evidence: The production contract separates measured Earth, interpreted site clues, fictional festival design, and the quarantined legacy artifact.

checks.name: source-digests
checks.evidence: Gate 1 source authority pins the terrain manifest, every consumed runtime layer, and Austen's connector trace by SHA-256.

checks.name: walkability
checks.evidence: All three registered pedestrian branches hold a 24.9% maximum ten-metre DTM grade against the 35% game-space cap; this is not an ADA field survey.

checks.name: clearance
checks.evidence: All registered route points remain inside the measured terrain footprint, and the Gate 2 contract reserves 0.8 m person, 3.0 m vehicle, and 3.0 m accessible game-space widths. Physical and ADA clearance remain field-unverified.

checks.name: vehicle-grade
checks.evidence: All registered vehicle branches hold a 24.7% maximum ten-metre DTM grade against the 30% game-space driving cap; the real road grade remains field-unverified.

checks.name: sightlines
checks.evidence: 8 of 8 expectations match: 4 terrain-plus-surface occlusions, 1 marginal terrain-plus-surface occlusion, 1 surface-only occlusion, and 2 clear relationships.

checks.name: final-view
checks.evidence: The registered dusk camera frames a 1.7 m composition target from all 49 points in its 3 m review neighbourhood; worst clearance is 1.61 m.

checks.name: arrival-topology
checks.evidence: Lower- and upper-tent branches unload, return through the lower gate, relocate to west upper parking, and walk home; lower car camping keeps the vehicle and skips relocation.

checks.name: return-route
checks.evidence: All three night returns terminate at their own branch campsite: lower-tent 247.4 m; upper-tent 224.0 m; car-camp 278.4 m.

checks.name: connector-registration
checks.evidence: Austen-traced connector centerlines are registered with measured >=2 m surface coverage: lower-to-middle 34.0%; upper-to-middle 47.1%; car-camp-to-middle 29.6%. Physical field precision remains unverified.

checks.name: connector-trace-lock
checks.evidence: The 13-vertex upper-to-middle trace and 14-vertex middle-to-lower trace captured 2026-08-25T20:41:21.633Z are source-locked to the registered orthophoto and embedded without vertex drift in every affected arrival and return branch.

checks.name: middle-earth-camping-exclusion
checks.evidence: All three campsite examples remain outside Middle Earth: lower-tent 186.6 m from its activity center; upper-tent 167.1 m from its activity center; car-camp 155.7 m from its activity center.

checks.name: lower-camping-separation
checks.evidence: Austen's placement keeps the representative lower-tent point outside the authored open-middle car-camping envelope. Both examples sit on measured open ground; no measured physical feature is claimed to divide them.

checks.name: zone-openness
checks.evidence: Middle Earth: no camping envelope 99.3% measured open; Car camping: open middle envelope 100.0% measured open

checks.name: route-visibility
checks.evidence: lower-tent-vehicle 25652 plan / 12738 sightline exact-color pixels; lower-tent-person 7938 plan / 3483 sightline exact-color pixels; upper-tent 12856 plan / 6187 sightline exact-color pixels; car-camp 5129 plan / 1993 sightline exact-color pixels
